rationale: The plan matches the reference: one DESeq2 model on all twelve samples with ~condition, an LRT against ~1 for the omnibus question, and two Wald contrasts against an explicitly releveled control with apeglm/ashr shrinkage, while correctly warning not to conflate LRT p-values with pairwise fold changes. QC (library sizes, VST PCA, correlation heatmap, outlier-reporting policy), a minimal row-sum<10 filter, and raw counts into DESeq2's own size factors are all stated. The |log2FC|>1 cutoff is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold in the test, costing fdr_shrinkage points. Enrichment was not requested; the added step names the post-filter universe but gives no collection version, size window, or GSEA ranking metric and leaves ORA-vs-GSEA unresolved. Reporting omits package versions.
